items.headline: RBI expected to maintain neutral stance on interest rates
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is widely anticipated to keep benchmark interest rates unchanged at its upcoming August monetary policy review, maintaining a neutral stance. This decision is supported by robust foreign capital inflows and government efforts to ease import-led inflation, despite recent upticks in inflation.

items.headline: India to adopt Producer Price Index for GDP deflation
items.summary: India is set to implement the Producer Price Index (PPI) as the new methodology for GDP deflation, a significant change in economic measurement.

items.headline: Government forms Task Force to boost India's toy sector
items.summary: Union Minister Piyush Goyal announced the formation of a Task Force aimed at supporting India's toy sector, with an ambitious goal of achieving a 5% global market share by 2032.

items.headline: Maharashtra becomes first state to qualify for second RKVY installment
items.summary: Maharashtra has achieved the distinction of being the first state to qualify for the second installment under the Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY).

items.headline: Indian equities eye higher opening amid mixed global cues
items.summary: Indian equity markets are anticipated to open higher, as indicated by the Gift Nifty, despite mixed trading in US equities overnight and varied performance across Asian markets.

items.headline: Oil prices jump over 4% due to West Asia tensions
items.summary: A fresh escalation in West Asia has caused oil prices to surge by more than 4%, which could introduce volatility into markets and weigh on risk appetite.

items.headline: Larsen & Toubro reports 14% rise in Q1 FY27 net profit
items.summary: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) announced a 14% year-on-year increase in net profit to ₹4,123 crore for Q1 FY27, with revenue growing by 7%.

items.headline: Birlasoft's Q1 FY27 net profit rises 11.8%
items.summary: Birlasoft reported an 11.8% increase in net profit to ₹99.4 crore and a 14.2% rise in revenue for Q1 FY27.

items.headline: Indus Towers Q1 FY27 net profit marginally up by 0.5%
items.summary: Indus Towers recorded a slight 0.5% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to ₹17.5 billion in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations up 4.6%.

items.headline: Suzlon Energy's Q1 FY27 net profit declines 6%
items.summary: Suzlon Energy reported a net profit of ₹3.05 billion for Q1 FY27, marking a 6% year-on-year decline.

items.headline: Paradeep Phosphates posts strong Q1 FY27 results with 23.8% net profit growth
items.summary: Paradeep Phosphates reported a significant 23.8% increase in net profit to ₹393 crore and a 36% rise in revenue for Q1 FY27.

items.headline: Phoenix Mills sees 77.3% surge in Q1 FY27 net profit
items.summary: Phoenix Mills reported a substantial 77.3% increase in net profit to ₹45.4 crore for Q1 FY27.

items.headline: VST Industries' Q1 FY27 net profit grows 23.2%
items.summary: VST Industries reported a 23.2% growth in net profit to ₹297 crore and a 12.8% increase in revenue for Q1 FY27.

items.headline: Aurionpro Solutions Q1 FY27 PAT declines 12.6%
items.summary: Aurionpro Solutions witnessed a 12.6% year-on-year decline in profit after tax (PAT) to ₹0.45 billion in Q1 FY27, despite achieving higher revenue.

items.headline: IT and Realty sectors lead gains; Nifty IT up 3%
items.summary: The IT and Realty sectors experienced strong buying interest, with Pharma, Midcap IT, and Consumer Durables also performing well. The Nifty IT Index notably gained over 3% due to strong earnings momentum in large-cap technology stocks.

items.headline: PSU Bank, FMCG, and Metal sectors face selling pressure
items.summary: Sectors including PSU Bank, FMCG, Chemicals, Banking, and Metal experienced selling pressure in the previous trading session.

items.headline: NCLAT approves Info Edge's subsidiary amalgamation
items.summary: The National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT) has approved the proposed amalgamation of four wholly-owned subsidiaries with Info Edge (India) Limited.

items.headline: Paradeep Phosphates to set up new aluminium fluoride plant
items.summary: Paradeep Phosphates' board approved the establishment of a 15,000 MTPA aluminium fluoride manufacturing plant at Paradeep, with an estimated investment of ₹250 crore.

items.headline: Rail Vikas Nigam secures ₹358.97 crore railway project
items.summary: Rail Vikas Nigam received a letter of acceptance for a ₹358.97 crore railway-doubling project from East Central Railway.

items.headline: Lemon Tree Hotels signs agreement for new property in Ujjain
items.summary: Lemon Tree Hotels signed a license agreement for a 51-room Keys Select by Lemon Tree Hotels property in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh.

items.headline: CDSL subsidiary gets SEBI nod for JV with Shoveltech Solutions
items.summary: Central Depository Services (CDSL) received SEBI approval for a joint venture agreement between its subsidiary Centrico Insurance Repository and Shoveltech Solutions.

items.headline: Indian Oil Corporation's Paradip Refinery updates operations
items.summary: Indian Oil Corporation's Paradip Refinery processed 16.35 MMT, commissioned SRU-III and NHGU, and its PX-PTA project is nearing completion.

items.headline: Deccan Gold Mines signs MoU for critical minerals research
items.summary: Deccan Gold Mines signed an MoU with CSIR-CECRI on research into critical minerals and battery materials.

items.headline: Grasim Industries repays ₹750 crore commercial paper
items.summary: Grasim Industries repaid ₹750 crore of commercial paper on maturity.

items.headline: Kolte Patil Developers' shareholders approve director reappointment
items.summary: Kolte Patil Developers' shareholders approved the reappointment of Girish Vanvari as an Independent Non-Executive Director for a second five-year term, effective July 29, 2026.

items.headline: Several companies to issue dividends on July 29
items.summary: Alembic Pharma, ASM Technology, Godrej Agrovet, IFGL Refractories, Rane (Madras), Route Mobile, Shakti Pumps (India), Siemens, TTK Prestige, and Ugar Sugar Works are scheduled to issue final or interim dividends on July 29.

items.headline: Corporate Laws Amendment Bill 2026 aims to streamline M&A
items.summary: The Corporate Laws Amendment Bill 2026, currently under examination by a Joint Parliamentary Committee, aims to streamline M&A processes by reducing tribunal timelines and clarifying procedural steps for cross-border mergers.

items.headline: Dynacons Systems & Solutions wins ₹267.58 crore NPCI contract
items.summary: Dynacons Systems & Solutions is in focus after securing a significant ₹267.58 crore contract from NPCI for data centre augmentation.

items.headline: Orissa Minerals Development gets environmental clearance for mine
items.summary: The Orissa Minerals Development Company received an environmental clearance recommendation for its Belkundi Iron & Manganese Ore Mine.

items.headline: ONGC board approves $500 million parent company guarantee
items.summary: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC)'s board approved providing a $500 million parent company guarantee.

items.headline: Suzlon Energy and Varun Beverages in focus after Q1 updates
items.summary: Suzlon Energy and Varun Beverages are expected to be in focus following their recent Q1 business updates.

items.headline: L&T, LIC, Birlasoft, Phoenix Mills expected to remain in focus after gains
items.summary: Larsen & Toubro, LIC, Birlasoft, and Phoenix Mills, which closed Tuesday's trading session in the green, are expected to remain in focus.

items.headline: TCS, Infosys among top gainers
items.summary: TCS and Infosys were among the top gainers in Tuesday's trading session.

items.headline: Bharat Elec, HUL, and NTPC among top losers
items.summary: Bharat Elec (Bharat Electronics), HUL (Hindustan Unilever), and NTPC were among the top losers in Tuesday's trading session.
